messages:
dera: initiating config-only deploy to prod for microbatch + token_budget tuning. change window 19:30-20:15 PT. canary 1% targeted to low-traffic routes.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: deploy_id=deploy-2934567001 mode=config-only canary=1%
mike: ack, oncall here. will watch tenant throttles and token charges.
ivy: paste diff in TOML for brevity:
```toml
[batching]
max_batch_tokens = 3072
max_batch_size = 32
microbatch_enabled = true
microbatch_slice_ms = 6

[routing]
priority = "cost-first"
min_route_weight_pct = 2

[timeouts]
head_ms = 900
stream_idle_ms = 30000
```
dera: launching canary
deploy-bot: canary live -> tweak variant receives 1% traffic
obs-bot: canary metrics (8m): p50=36ms, p95=140ms, p99=275ms, error_rate=0.00%, cost_per_1k_tokens=$0.82
mike: noticed small rise in token billing for high-qps tenants but latency improved. tracing shows microbatch scheduling overhead on some large requests.
ivy: proposal: reduce microbatch_slice_ms -> 4 and cap microbatch per-request to 2 slices for affected routes. plan hotpatch to canary only.
dera: pause ramp. apply hotpatch: `/deploy config-only --patch '{"batching":{"microbatch_slice_ms":4,"microbatch_max_slices":2}}' --to prod --variant=tweak --canary 1%`
deploy-bot: hotpatch started: patch_id=patch-2934568001 status=canarying
obs-bot: hotpatch metrics (4m): p50=35ms, p95=138ms, p99=260ms, error_rate=0.00%, token_cost_down=6%
mike: looks good. recommend ramp to 20% with 10m step.
deploy-bot: ramping patch-2934568001 -> 20% over 10m
obs-bot: 20% stable after 11m. p95 steady, p99 improved, no error increase, tenant throttles unchanged.
dera: pinning config cfg-ff12 to variant v14-beta for 36h as a safety measure. rollback criteria: tenant 5xx > 0.3% OR sustained p99 delta +220ms for 5m. rollback command: `/deploy rollback deploy-2934567001`
ivy: release notes draft: "Config-only: enabled microbatching, set microbatch_slice_ms 6->4 (hotpatch), max_batch_tokens 4096->3072, max_batch_size 64->32; routing.priority set to cost-first with min_route_weight_pct=2%; pinned to v14-beta for 36h." change window closed 19:42 PT.
mike: owners: deploy-owner=dera, rollback-owner=ivy. thanks team, closing unless alerts fire. :white_check_mark:
